blocks.summary: US House blocks bid to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, for now. Trump welcomes the outcome, praising Hegseth as a "Great American Patriot", but Democrats can try again next year.

blocks.summary: Microsoft’s DLSS competitor is out for the Xbox Ally X and works in handheld mode. The Xbox Ally X.  | Photo by Amelia Holowaty Krales / The Verge Microsoft is now rolling out Automatic Super Resolution (Auto SR), an upscaling technology that competes with Nvidia's DLSS, for the Xbox Ally X, Xbox Ally X20, and select Windows Copilot Plus PCs, the company announced today.
